evidence.text: When the door is opened slowly, an audible click should be heard at the same time or successively at intervals and the latches should activate the switches with an audible click. If the latches do not activate the switches when the door is closed, the switches should be adjusted in accordance with the adjustment procedure. Disconnect the wire lead from the primary switch. Connect the ohmmeter leads to the common (COM) and normally open (NO) terminal of the switch. The meter should indicate an open circuit in the door open condition. When the door is closed, the meter should indicate a closed circuit.
If the primary switch operation is abnormal, make the necessary adjustment or replace the switch, making sure to replace it with the same type of switch.

1.Press “Defrost weight/time” for 2 seconds , unit will display “TEST” and Beep once;

conditions.text: The unit checks whether the PCB humidity sensor and PCB thermistor are short or open; if an error exists, it beeps and displays an error code.
Press Defrost weight/time for 2 seconds to start the test; the unit displays TEST and beeps once.

After applying power, verify interlock-switch mechanism operation by opening and closing the door, and ensure microwave energy leakage is below 5 mW/cm2; make service adjustments for minimum leakage readings.

After repair, check that the interlock monitor switch is connected correctly and firmly, the magnetron gasket is correctly positioned and mounted, the waveguide and oven cavity are intact with no microwave leakage, the door closes properly and safety switches work properly, and the unit stops when the door is opened or time is up. Do not operate the unit with any of these components removed or bypassed.

Before applying power, verify proper operation of the primary, secondary, and monitor interlock switches by opening and closing the door several times; verify that the door perforated screen and dielectric choke are correctly and firmly mounted.

Do not operate the unit until completely repaired. Do not operate it if the door does not close firmly, the hinge is broken, the door seal is damaged, the door is bent or warped, there is other visible damage that may cause microwave leakage, interlock parts are defective, or parts in the microwave-generating and transmission assembly (especially the waveguide) are defective. Keep the seal clean.

Some circuits contain nearly 4,000 volts. Exercise extreme caution around the magnetron filament leads, which carry high voltage relative to ground. Never plug the unit into a power source to determine which high-voltage-section component is defective.
